senses.gloss:
r. 10th cl. (मोलयति)
To plant: more usually मूल.

r. 1st cl. (मूलति-ते)
To stand, to be rooted or firm.
r. 10th cl. (मूलयति)
1 To plant or transplant.
2 To grow as a plant, to sprout, to shoot or germinate.
With उद् prefixed,
to root up or out, to eradicate, to exterminate.

n. (-लं)
1 A root, the root of a tree, &c.
2 Origin, commencement.
3 Capital, principal.
4 Near, proximate.
5 Own, peculiar, proper.
6 The root of the Arum campanulatum.
7 The original text of any work, as opposed to the Ṭīkā or comment.
mn. (-लः-लं)
The nineteenth lunar asterism, containing eleven stars, which appear to be the same as those in the SCORPION'S tail.
f. (-ली)
A small house lizard.
E.
मूल to stand, to be rooted or firm, aff. क, or मू to bind, Uṇādi aff. क्ल.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 The radish, (Raphanus sativus.)
2 A large, sort of yam.
m. (-कः)
A sort of poison.
E.
मूल a root, कन् added.

m. (-णः)
A handful of radishes, &c. for sale.
E.
मूलक, and पण measure.

f. (-ला)
A plant, commonly Kṣīrakākolī.

n. (-र्म्म)
Magic.
E.
मूल original or essential, and कर्म्मन् act.

f. (-का)
A fire place.
E.
मूल primary, (work,) and कारिका an agent.

n. (-च्छ्रं)
A sort of penance, subsisting for a given time on the roots of plants only.
E.
मूल a root, and कृच्छ्र penance.

m. (-कः)
A digger for roots.
E.
मूल, and खानक a digger.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born from a root, &c.
m. (-जः)
A plant growing from a root, as a lotus, &c.
E.
मूल a root, and ज born.

m. (-वः)
A name of KAṂSA, the uncle of KṚṢṆA.
E.
मूल original, and देव a deity; the incarnation of a demi-god.

n. (-व्यं)
Capital, principal, stock.
E.
मूल capital, and द्रव्य substance.

n. (-नं)
Capital, principal, stock.
E.
मूल capital, and धन wealth.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, (Hydrocotyle asiatica.)

m. (-द्रः)
A name of KAṂSA, the uncle of KṚṢṆA.
E.
मूल origin, and भद्र auspicious.

m. (-त्यः)
An old or hereditary servant.
E.
मूल, and भृत्य dependant.

m. (-जः)
A car, a carriage.
E.
मूल the root, (the axle,) and विभुज what bends.

mfn. (-टः-टी-टं)
Fit or cultivated for esculent roots, (as the arum, the radish, and others, a field, &c.)
E.
मूल a root, and शाकट aff.; also with शाकिन aff. मूलशाकिन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं).

n. (-नं)
1 Ether, heaven, space or atmosphere.
2 GOD.
f. (-नी)
GAURĪ.
E.
मूल primary origin, &c., and स्थान place, abode.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Radical, (literal or figurative,) primary, principal.
m. (-कः)
A devotee, living on roots.
E.
मूल a root, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Having a root, stock, origin, &c.
m. (-ली)
A tree.
E.
मूल a root, aff. इनि.

m. (-रः)
Indian spikenard.
E.
मूल to be rooted, Uṇādi aff. एरक्.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
1 To be eradicated, to be pulled or plucked up by the root.
2 To be bent from the root, &c.
3 To be bought, purchasable.
4 To be bought for a fair or just price.
n. (-ल्यं)
1 Price.
2 Wages, hire.
3 An article purchased.
E.
मूल principal, and यत् aff.
